reviews.text:
I was looking for a trusted exotic store that could supply items that I needed for my snake Tank. I’ve placed an order hoping to receive the requested items ,but so far the experience has been questionable. Their website states that deliveries can take between 3-5 business days, my order has been open with no updates for almost a month now.
I’ve reached out via email , which I haven’t received any replies,and I’ve called multiple times now which the responses are either 1)the person responsible is not here ;2) the person responsible is out finishing a delivery; 3) the person answering the call is not experienced to deal with delivery queries or 4) Nobody answers.

Absolutely disappointing.

I’m sorry to leave a negative comment, especially as the staff member was very respectful and the place itself was clean and well maintained. However, I personally find it very difficult to see animals being kept in cages primarily for human entertainment, especially when these are wild animals that are neither suited to an urban environment nor domesticated.

I understand that people may have different views on this, but seeing animals in these conditions genuinely made me feel sad and uncomfortable. These are animals whose natural environment and needs are very different from what we can provide in a cage, and I believe their wellbeing should come before our desire to see or interact with them.

I truly hope that, in the future, we move towards more respectful ways of appreciating animals that prioritise their freedom, natural behaviour and wellbeing.
